# Inke AI

> Inke AI provides AI customer support for e-commerce and owned customer channels, with a knowledge base built around each business.

Inke AI is preparing to launch. The product brings natural, knowledgeable customer support to e-commerce stores and a business's own customer channels, powered by a knowledge base built around that business.
